source_caption:
Gridlocked — Trapped in the Crossfire

Gridlocked (2015) follows former SWAT leader David Hendrix, who is forced to work with Brody Walker, a reckless movie star placed under his protection after getting into trouble.

What should have been a simple assignment quickly turns into a nightmare when heavily armed criminals attack the police facility where they are staying. Suddenly trapped inside the building, Hendrix and Walker have no choice but to put their differences aside and fight their way through the growing threat.

As the attack intensifies, the unlikely pair must learn to trust each other. Hendrix relies on his tactical experience, while Walker is forced to prove that he is more capable than everyone initially believes.

The film explores themes of teamwork, trust, redemption, courage, and survival. Two completely different men are pushed into the same dangerous situation, forcing them to discover what they are capable of when there is nowhere left to run.

What makes Gridlocked compelling is the unexpected partnership between a hardened former officer and a spoiled celebrity. Their constant clashes add humor while the action keeps the story moving.

💬 They were trapped together—and surviving meant learning to fight as a team.

source_details.synopsis: Gridlocked is a 2015 Canadian action thriller film directed by Allan Ungar and co-written by Ungar and Rob Robol. It had its world premiere at Fantastic Fest on September 26, 2015, and stars Dominic Purcell, Stephen Lang, Danny Glover, Trish Stratus, and Saul Rubinek. The film was purchased by Netflix and became available worldwide on July 14, 2016. The film is about a former SWAT leader, David Hendrix (Dominic Purcell), who is reluctantly helping an arrogant movie star, Brody Walker (Cody Hackman), to do a justice diversion program. The pair faces a deadly challenge when the police training facility they are visiting is attacked by mercenaries seeking items from an evidence locker.
